en.headline: VTC opens applications for 2027/28 programmes with expanded places
en.dek: The Vocational Training Council begins accepting applications today for about 140 full-time programmes, increasing overall study places by more than 10 percent to over 14,000.
body: The Vocational Training Council said applications for its 2027/28 academic year programmes open today, Thursday, covering bachelor’s degrees, higher diplomas, foundation diplomas and other offerings across its member institutions.

To meet demand for vocational and professional education, VTC is increasing overall study places by more than 10 percent to over 14,000. Students can apply through a single portal for programmes offered by different member institutions. Those who submit applications by 28 February 2027 may receive conditional offers from late March 2027.

VTC will hold information and experience days on 6-7 and 13-14 November, with talks, interactive sessions and campus tours for Secondary 6 students, parents and teachers. The programmes are aligned with areas such as AI, aviation, engineering and other sectors identified in the government’s five-year plan.

zh.headline: 職業訓練局今日起接受2027/28學年課程申請 學額增逾一成
zh.dek: 職訓局今日起接受約140項全日制課程報名，整體學額增加超過一成至逾14,000個，方便中六學生規劃升學。
body: 職業訓練局表示，2027/28學年課程申請今日（星期四）起接受，涵蓋學士學位、高級文憑、基礎課程文憑、職專文憑及文憑課程，由轄下院校提供。
為配合職業專才教育需求，職訓局將整體學額增加超過一成至超過14,000個。學生可透過單一平台一次申請多間院校課程。於明年2月28日或之前報名的同學，有機會於3月下旬獲發有條件取錄通知。
職訓局將於11月6至7日及13至14日舉行課程資訊及體驗日，安排講座、互動體驗及校園參觀，協助中六學生、家長及教師了解課程。課程對接人工智能、航空、工程等重點範疇。
